test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
With reference to Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, consider the following statements.

a) They are also called the Indian Councils Act, 1909.

b) They increased the strength of Legislative Councils.

c) The right to separate electorate was given to the Muslims.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**a,b,c**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, also known as the Indian Councils Act of 1909, were significant constitutional reforms introduced by the British government in India.
 
• They are known for their impact on Indian politics during the colonial period.
 
• Statement I: They are also called the Indian Councils Act, of 1909.
 
 
• The statement is Correct.
